name: Lit-Tensor Shading
definition: A shading model for tensor splats based on Kindlmann et al.'s lit-tensor model, which is a Blinn-Phong lighting model where diffuse and specular components depend on the light direction, half-way vector, and tensor-derived normal.
summary: Lit-Tensor Shading illuminates tensor splats to visualize direction and curvature in tensor fields by deriving surface normals from principal axes, distinguishing itself by using illumination rather than color to convey geometric structure.
